notablePrerequisites:
Nonland permanent card(s) you own that can produce at least {2}{U} exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Deadeye Navigator is paired with Abdel Adrian.
description:
Activate Abdel Adrian by paying {1}{U}, blinkng itself.
Abdel Adrian leaves and enters the battlefield, causing all cards exiled with it to return to the battlefield from exile, and triggering Abdel Adrian's enters-the-battlefield ability and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Holding priority, activate the nonland mana-producing permanent(s) by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Abdel Adrian.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling the nonland mana-producing permanent(s) and creating that many 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Each Soldier enters the battlefield, triggering Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability that many times.
Resolve all Deadeye Navigator triggers, choosing not to pair it and a Soldier token.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use Deadeye Navigator's abilities to blink any number of creatures you control any number of times.
